thought.text:
My implementation is flawed. `reader.get_marked()` returns the whole line from the mark, not the `=` portion, and `peek(2).startswith("#")` is always true when `char == "#"`. Let me reconsider.

The key insight: `_equal_sign = r"(=[^\S\r\n]*)"` consumes `=` plus trailing whitespace. So I need to know whether whitespace was consumed. The cleanest approach is to capture the equal-sign match and check if it contained whitespace.
